MOD_CONST = 10**9 + 7

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

try:
    while True:
        p = int(input())
        k = int(input())
        if k == 0:
            print(mod_pow(p, p - 1, MOD_CONST))
            continue
        if k == 1:
            print(mod_pow(p, p, MOD_CONST))
            continue
        visited = [False] * p
        total_cycles = 0
        for i in range(1, p):
            if visited[i]:
                continue
            j = i
            cycle_length = 0
            while not visited[j]:
                visited[j] = True
                j = (j * k) % p
                cycle_length += 1
            if mod_pow(k, cycle_length, p) == 1:
                total_cycles += 1
        print(mod_pow(p, total_cycles, MOD_CONST))
except EOFError:
    pass
